name: Safari & Wildlife
blurb: Game drives, walking safaris and river crossings, led by guides who read the bush.
detail: Days built around the best light: early mornings, long middle hours at camp, and late drives into golden dusk. Where conservancies allow it, we add walking and night drives.

name: Culture & Community
blurb: Homestead visits, markets, craft and food, arranged respectfully and on local terms.
detail: Visits are arranged with the communities themselves, with time and a fair share of the value staying local. We favour smaller, hosted encounters over staged performances.

name: Beach & Coast
blurb: Indian Ocean water, dhow sailing and quiet sand after time on the plains.
detail: The natural companion to a safari: shallow warm water, reef snorkelling, sailing and long unstructured afternoons. Coastal stays are chosen for access to the water and quiet at night.

name: Adventure
blurb: Rafting, gorges, balloon flights and highland trails for travellers who want to move.
detail: Adventure is added in proportion to the rest of the trip — a single big day, or a route built around movement for travellers who want it.

name: Nature & Landscapes
blurb: Rift Valley escarpments, craters, forests and the mountain horizons between them.
detail: For travellers who care as much about the landscape as the wildlife: viewpoints, forests, crater floors and long drives with something to see.

name: City & Food
blurb: Markets, spice farms, coffee and the food cultures of the coast and the highlands.
detail: Half-days built around markets, cooking and tasting, usually at the start or end of a trip when you are already in town.
